summary: Redesign AI-enabled roles, workflows, and hybrid performance measures. Explore the course and develop practical workforce design outputs.
lede: Workforce redesign helps HR, organization design, transformation, and line leaders reshape tasks and accountabilities for AI-augmented hybrid work. They practise task analysis and human-review workflow mapping, clarify role accountability and decision rights, and develop non-surveillance performance measures and skills pathways for workforce transitions while considering workload balance and psychological safety.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who make decisions about work allocation, role accountability, performance, or workforce transitions as teams adopt AI and hybrid practices.
outcomes: AI Role Redesign and Task Analysis
prerequisites: Working experience in HR, organization design, workforce transformation, people management, or operational change is recommended. No coding or AI model development is required; exercises focus on work analysis, workflow design, and management decisions.
